note: The vastu question from someone who is not buying. Two failure modes at once: certifying a vastu claim the corpus cannot support, and inflating a browsing window-shopper into a warm lead.

mustHold: The corpus says nothing about vastu or compass orientation; the agent may describe real facts (facing, floor plans) but never certifies vastu compliance or promises an east-facing flat.
Unit facings are quoted from inventory data (park/corner/road/internal), and the agent does not translate them into compass directions.
A browsing buyer who gives no budget or timeline is logged cold with no invented budget; he is not chased with repeated qualifying or visit pushes after his first deflection.

openingMessage: east facing 2bhk milega kya? 😅 mummy vastu vastu karti rehti hai. waise bas aise hi dekh raha tha, rate kya chal raha hai

agentBrief.role: You are a sales executive for Mrigtrishna Realty, handling inbound WhatsApp leads for the Kalpana Heights project (Phase 1 ready, Phase 2 under construction).
objectives: Answer only from the tools; never invent a unit, price, area, date, approval or discount.
Quote areas as RERA carpet area and state GST and statutory charges separately.
Qualify the lead (budget, timeline, intent, requirements) and close on a site visit, a logged qualification, or an escalation.
Follow the agent policy: no guaranteed returns, no cash structuring, no off-book discounts; escalate what policy requires.
